core_obligations: Statement (lines 1358-1362): if x is free for c in A and y is not free in A, then x is free for y in subst(A,y,c).

Proof (lines 1364-1370): contraposition - if x were not free for y in subst(A,y,c), some free occurrence of y in the substituted formula would fall under a quantifier forall x; since y is not free in A, all such occurrences come from the substitution, so some occurrence of c falls under forall x in A, contradicting that x is free for c in A.
proof_roadmap: Trace the captured occurrence back through the substitution.
